title: Fix an expression with a quick fix
description: Write a calc rule's expression with a common mistake, read the plain-words diagnostic the field gives on the spot, apply its one-click fix, and save the rule.

steps.caption: Calc rules derive a value from others. This one counts a component's slow endpoints.
It reads TCP connect time, one value per endpoint, as the list tcp_connect_time.
It writes a metric of its own. Register it here.
Create it. The rule now writes it.
Count the endpoints slower than 50 ms. A sum is the natural first guess.
The field explains the mistake on the sum itself, links its code to the docs, and offers a fix.
Use count rewrites it in one click. Ctrl-Z would take it back.
Now it compiles and yields a number, as the metric needs.
Save it. The rule computes whenever an endpoint's time changes.
Its blade shows the expression it computes by.
